description:
List every captured user journey: onboarding flows, signup sequences, checkout processes,
booking flows, and marketplace explorations. Shows step counts, flow type, and observed
transitions between steps.

Use this to find complete user journey references—not just individual screens—so you can
see how products guide users through multi-step processes like signup, onboarding, or checkout.

flowType.description: Only return flows of this type.

name: list_flows

branchCount.description: Steps that are alternate branches (not the main path).

scope.description:
What was captured. marketing: logged-out marketing pages only. public-demo: logged out, but real
product surfaces or public demos were used. task-incomplete: signed in, but the journey stops before
its result. signed-in: signed in, and the journey reaches its result.

title: List captured onboarding flows
